display_name: 固定恢复器对微弱源IQ变化的响应：IQ与连续F0特征
description: 原L_s/U_s固定224条、四种1%源RMS合成变化、记录的真实源Action与同一次噪声；三版final30、七种源场景。
authorization: User source-only restoration/fingerprint mechanism and efficiency research. Original L_s/U_s only, frozen continuous F0 features; no training, TX labels, V/OE or target inputs.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI CPU2 nice10 CUDA empty, FP32 networks and original FP64 posteriors.

data.version: Original R07 draw1 source training cache, fixed224 unique records:35L_s/189U_s.
data.representation: Original clean/received IQ2x256 plus saved simulator FIR/main/image/noise traces. No new noise draw or RMS renormalization.
data.contract_ref: OriginalTriSIGSSL F0 source_contract andsource_pair metadata;R07 original63000source physicalset/roles matchbyID
data.physical_ids_ref: Fixed first matching source rows per scene:oneL_s+fiveU_s per each of fiveRX, then two additionalU_s.32 per scene; seven scenes,224 distinct original physical IDs.
data.label_map_ref: No TX truth or classifier head calls. Continuous original F0 features only.
data.tx_sets_ref: Original six known sourceTX; V trueTX validation only, no train/selection
data.validation_ref: Original VALIDATED_ONCE R07/capsule/split and exact three final30 model source provenance; source-only actual checkpoint smoke.
data.leo_config_ref: Existing R07 draw1 only. Same recorded simulator Action propagates the four small source perturbations.
data.actual_training_labels: No training or truth reads; label-hidden source IQ and simulator traces only.
data.augmentation: Fixed1% source-RMS conjugate, amplitude cubic, phase slope and local difference. Each source observation retains the original realized noise.

permissions.query_use: 224 legal L_s/U_s, zero TX/V/OE/target/optimization or classification-head calls.
permissions.claim_scope: Energy-weighted finite-difference response to synthetic source proxies. Not actual TX identity, a deployment oracle, Main accuracy or a universal recovery bound.

checkpoint.initialization: Same original three source-only final30 G and original F0, all frozen.
sources: SOURCE_INPUTS original R07 L_s/U_s draw1 and same known simulator Action/noise; no V cache opened.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Strict three original final30 configs/commits/7410 and zero V/target training provenance. Actual3G/F0 feature smoke before full source matrix.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only final30 family, no target-selected checkpoint. Same family as pre-Main E20 and full30 source comparison.
checkpoint.selection_rule: All three fixed final30 versions, all seven source scenes and all four directions; fixed1% strength, no case/direction/model selection.

execution.gpu_policy: One CPU2 nice10 prediction child, CUDA empty. No truth scorer or GPU worker.
execution.stop_rule: Wrong source/parent/F0 handles, immutable output collision, failed source smoke, degenerate synthetic IQ direction, nonfinite output or posterior residual>1e-8: preserve and stop, no automatic restart or case omission.

metric_names: IQ delta projection gain, normalized squared response error and norm ratio; matching continuousF0 delta statistics.
Per-record reference/response energy, inner product and squared error; cell ratios formed from sums. Exact zero-reference rows counted, undefined ratios remain null.
All84 method/scene/direction cells plus all per-record saved vectors, independently recomputed after completion; no TX scoring.
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: 3360 G/F0 output rows,1120 clean F0 reference rows,6 extra source smoke rows.84 complete response cells; no classification logits or truth.
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent CPU NumPy arithmetic on saved response vectors, no truth connection.

rows.purpose: Measure whether pointwise restoration preserves weak input changes and their continuous feature directions.
rows.seed_notes: Fixed original record order and original F0; no new RNG or phase selection.
rows.scenario: Original source V480 x7, five inference-only readouts.
rows.budget_ref: 224 source records x three models x(base+four perturbed)=3360 G calls,1120 clean F0 and3360 restored F0; extra6 smoke rows. CPU2, zero optimizer updates.

notes: The four fixed direction definitions and1% scale match the existing source perturbation convention; this probe uses recorded true simulator Action rather than a model-estimated action.
Frozen original source models re-estimate all internal quantities on perturbed received IQ. No cached context shortcut or deployment change.
Three new numerical/boundary tests and five reused parent/protocol tests PASS. One independent P0/P1 review PASS. Actual3G/originalF0 continuous-feature smoke first, then full matrix.
No source TX labels, V/OE/target samples, default-head calls, gradients, optimizer steps or model-state updates.
Small or large synthetic response is not automatically good identity recovery; response can include nuisance amplification. Undefined zero-reference feature ratios are not replaced with zero.
All other training/test budgets and versions continue unchanged.
